about: The move model's moves (PLAN.md WP-6.2, D71; @m3a/core procedural.moveClip): angles in degrees, reach in arm lengths, heights, lunges and hops in % of the hip height (a hand's height above the shoulders' centre, a kick's above the floor), times in seconds. From my-3d2dge's E.MOVES (the first 24, checked against spec/vectors/frozen/moves.json) and shardfall's anim/moves.toml (the about lines and the last 7), written by node tools/procedural/carry.ts. Shape: spec/schemas/moves.schema.json.

moves.name: slash
moves.about: a level sword swing from the right shoulder across to the left; alternate swings come back as a backslash

moves.name: backslash
moves.about: a backhanded level swing from the left side across to the right

moves.name: overhead
moves.about: the blade raised high behind the head and chopped straight down in front, crouching into it

moves.name: rising
moves.about: a rising cut from low in front to high overhead, hopping up with it

moves.name: thrust
moves.about: a straight stab: the arm draws back to the hip and drives forward at full reach with a long lunge

moves.name: spinslash
moves.about: the blade held out to the side as the whole body turns a full circle

moves.name: plunge
moves.about: a downward stab: the blade driven point-first into something on the ground

moves.name: twohand
moves.about: a heavy two-handed chop: both hands on the grip, raised high and brought down with the whole body

moves.name: jab
moves.about: a quick straight punch with the lead (left) fist, the right fist guarding the chin

moves.name: cross
moves.about: a straight right punch thrown across with the hips and shoulders turning into it

moves.name: hook
moves.about: a looping right punch swung in from the side at head height

moves.name: uppercut
moves.about: a crouch, then a rising right fist driven up under the chin with a small hop

moves.name: haymaker
moves.about: a huge wound-up right punch swung round from far behind

moves.name: elbow
moves.about: a short right elbow strike turned in at close range

moves.name: kick
moves.about: a straight front kick at the belly, leaning back for balance

moves.name: roundhouse
moves.about: a high kick swung round from the side to head height, the body turning with it

moves.name: sweep
moves.about: a low spinning leg sweep along the ground from a deep crouch

moves.name: flyingkick
moves.about: a jumping kick: the body leaves the ground and drives one foot forward

moves.name: knee
moves.about: a knee driven up into the body at close range

moves.name: axekick
moves.about: the leg swung straight up high and chopped down heel first

moves.name: cast
moves.about: both hands drawn up to the chest, then pushed out together to release a spell

moves.name: throw
moves.about: an overarm throw: the hand winds far back above the shoulder and whips forward

moves.name: bash
moves.about: a short heavy shove with both hands: a pommel, a shield or a shoulder

moves.name: claw
moves.about: a raking swipe from high on the right down and across the body

moves.name: whirlwind
moves.about: a whirlwind: both arms out wide and the whole body turning a full circle, again and again

moves.name: roar
moves.about: a war cry: arms flung wide and high, chest out, leaning back

moves.name: leap
moves.about: a leaping strike: a deep crouch, the blade raised overhead as the body flies, chopped down on landing

moves.name: lunge
moves.about: a pounce: both hands reaching forward as the body springs into them

moves.name: stir
moves.about: stirring a pot: the right hand sweeps a slow low arc from left to right

moves.name: stir_back
moves.about: stirring a pot, the other way: the right hand sweeps from right to left

moves.name: flick
moves.about: a coin flicked up from the right hand
